newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - March 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - March 6.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Bangladesh President Shahabuddin Ahmed on Wednesday said that the visit of President Fidel Ramos of the Philippines would give a tremendous boost to the relations between the two countries.
A Japanese economic team on Wednesday said Tokyo would continue to extend cooperation to Bangladesh, but cautioned that future assistance could decline significantly.
Opposition lawmakers on Wednesday lashed out at the government for political patronage of bureaucrats and bank defaulters creating chaos in the administration and in the financial sector.
Bangladesh Scout will confer the highest scout award, "The Silver Tiger", on the Philippines President Fidel Ramos in recognition of his contribution to the scout movement.
New Pakistan governemnt pledged to further promote ties with Bangladesh, said Bangladesh Foreign Minister Abdus Samad Azad on return from Islamabad on Wednesday.
The visiting Filipino President Fidel Ramos has invited Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to visit the Phillipines.
A Swedish business forum in Bangladesh with a view to boost trade and investment between the two countries will open soon.
Two joint venture agreements, one on infrastructure development and the other on establishing a computer school, may be signed on Thursday between Bangladesh and Philippines.
